scope: Production source under src/ and worker/src/, excluding *.test.* and *.spec.*. Test configuration and the e2e/ tree are out of scope by construction, not by exclusion.
rule: Every production file containing a demonstration, mock, fixture or dummy token must be listed here with one line of justification. An addition requires an ADR (brief G8.2(c)). A listed file that no longer matches is a stale entry and fails the gate.
